newsitem.title: USA: GTE plans to buy up to $200 mln CANTV shrs.
newsitem.headline: GTE plans to buy up to $200 mln CANTV shrs.

text.p: GTE Corp said on Wednesday it plans to acquire up to $200 million of the shares of Venezuelan telephone company, Compaa Annima Nacional Telfonos de Venezuela, or CANTV.
GTE, which said it placed an order for the shares with global coordinators Lehman Brothers and SBC Warburg, would pay a price within the range of $21.50 to $24.50 per ADR share.
GTE already owns about 20.4 percent of CANTV through the VenWorld consortium of which GTE owns 51 percent.
CANTV started a public offering of its shares earlier this month.
